name: 22508 · Locust Grove, VA
findings: ZIP 22508 (Locust Grove) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22508 (Locust Grove) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22508 (Locust Grove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
